entries.1f5e00697fddf8ad: A company that manufactures and sells end mills, cutting tools that cut metal and other materials on machining centers, specializing in small-diameter carbide ones.
entries.29e3469133f8c3ed: These are end mills with a cutting diameter over 6 mm. Sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥799 million.
entries.3818d22d35174312: Manufacturing customers who purchase through agents
entries.73655f2f9cedc26b: These are end mills with a cutting diameter of 6 mm or less. Sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥7,635 million.
entries.7cfe9a6c1e4848d7: These are end mills not included in the above size categories. Sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥365 million.
entries.bbb1ffae426586b5: This is a business segment that manufactures and sells plastic molded products, mainly tool cases. Because its sales and other amounts are each less than 10% of the total of all segments, it is not included in the reportable segments, and its amounts are not disclosed separately. In the sales results by product category, it is included under "Others".
entries.d12cb7fc692a524c: Manufacturers related to semiconductors and electronic components
